body.NotificationContent:
🔒 Vulnerability Scan Complete

Cycle ID: @{variables('cycleId')}

Dear Security Team,

We are pleased to inform you that the vulnerability triaging process has been successfully completed and validated for scan cycle @{variables('cycleId')}.

📋 Scan Summary

  • Status: ✅ Completed & Validated
  • Cycle ID: @{variables('cycleId')}
  • Completion Date: @{utcNow('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')} UTC
  • Validation Status: @{variables('validationStatus')}

📊 Final Report Available

File Name: @{variables('finalReportName')}

Location: @{variables('finalReportFolderPath')}

📄 Open Final Report

📁 Open Report Folder

If you cannot access the file, please contact your SharePoint administrator

inputs.body:
{
  "taskId": "@{variables('taskId')}",
  "workflowName": "ScopeValidate-Report",
   "recipientName": "Scoping Triaging Team",
  "taskTitle": "Action Required: Scoping Triaging Validation for Vulnerability Report - @{variables('taskId')}",
  "taskDescription": "Scoping triaging validation required for vulnerability report. Cycle: @{variables('cycleId')}", 
  "reminderCount": 0,
  "maxReminderCount": 3,
  "escalationLevel": 1,
  "escalateAfterMaxReminders": true,
  "NotificationChannels": [
    "Email",
    "Teams"
  ],
"TemplateVariables": [
    {
        "key": "taskId",
        "value": "@{variables('taskId')}"
    },
    {
        "key": "cycleId",
        "value": "@{variables('cycleId')}"
    },
    {
        "key": "requestedDateTime",
        "value": "@{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}"
    }
],
"RecipientList": [
    "IVM_Team"
  ],
  "TeamsList": [
    "IVM_Team"
  ],
  "TemplateId": "REPORT-07",
  "dueDate": "@{variables('dueDate')}",
  "priority": "High",
  "callbackType": "logicApp",
  "callbackUri": "@{parameters('callbackUrl')}",
  "executeAfterHours": 2,
  "executeOnlyIfTaskPending": true,
  "authenticationRequired": false,
  "callbackParameters": {
    "cycleId": "@{variables('cycleId')}",
   "triagingSheetPath": "@{variables('finaltriagingSheetPath')}",
   "validationDueDate": "@{formatDateTime(addDays(utcNow(),2), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')}",
   "taskId": "@{variables('taskId')}"
  }
}
